","iterations":250000};
const b64=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
async function unlock(password){
  const baseKey=await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw",new TextEncoder().encode(password),"PBKDF2",false,["deriveKey"]);
  const key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:"PBKDF2",salt:b64(P.salt),iterations:P.iterations,hash:"SHA-256"},baseKey,{name:"AES-GCM",length:256},false,["decrypt"]);
  const plain=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:"AES-GCM",iv:b64(P.iv)},key,b64(P.ct));
  sessionStorage.setItem("study_session_pw",password);
  let html=new TextDecoder().decode(plain);
  const navPatch = `
<style id="ipad-question-nav-fix">
@media(max-width:1100px){
  #navigator.top-qnav{margin:0 0 12px;border-radius:14px;max-width:none;width:100%}
  #navigator.top-qnav .question-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(38px,1fr));max-height:175px;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px}
  #navigator.top-qnav .grid-legend{margin-top:8px}
  #navigator.top-qnav summary{font-size:13px}
}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  const nav=document.getElementById('navigator');
  const sidebar=document.querySelector('.sidebar');
  const main=document.querySelector('.main-column');
  const anchor=main && main.querySelector('.filterbar');
  if(!nav||!sidebar||!main||!anchor)return;
  const marker=document.createElement('span');
  marker.hidden=true;
  nav.parentNode.insertBefore(marker,nav);
  const mq=window.matchMedia('(max-width:1100px)');
  function syncNav(){
    if(mq.matches){
      if(nav.parentNode!==main) main.insertBefore(nav,anchor);
      nav.classList.add('top-qnav');
      nav.open=true;
    }else{
      if(nav.parentNode!==sidebar) marker.parentNode.insertBefore(nav,marker.nextSibling);
      nav.classList.remove('top-qnav');
    }
  }
  syncNav();
  if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change',syncNav);
  else if(mq.addListener) mq.addListener(syncNav);
})();
<\/script>
`;
  html=html.replace('</body>',navPatch+'</body>');
  document.open();document.write(html);document.close();
}
document.getElementById("login").addEventListener("submit",async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();const pw=document.getElementById("pw").value;
  document.getElementById("err").textContent="正在解密…";
  try{await unlock(pw);}catch(err){document.getElementById("err").textContent="密碼不正確，請再試一次。";}
});
const remembered=sessionStorage.getItem("study_session_pw");
if(remembered)unlock(remembered).catch(()=>sessionStorage.removeItem("study_session_pw"));
</script>
</body>
</html>
